children: The Company announces that, further to the announcement made on 29 October 2026, the change of the Company's name to Eurowag Group plc has been registered at Companies House taking effect on 4 November 2026 and the London Stock Exchange has been notified of the change.
Trading in the Company's ordinary shares under the new company name is expected to commence at 8.00 am on 5 November 2026.
The Company's TIDM (EWG), ISIN (GB00BLGXWY71), SEDOl (BLGXWY7) and Legal Entity Identifier (213800HU63CWV5J8YK95) remain unchanged.

Shareholder documents of title will be unaffected by the change of name and existing share certificates should be retained as they remain valid. Any new share certificates to be issued will bear the new name, Eurowag Group plc.

Eurowag is a leading technology company serving Europe's commercial road transport ("CRT") industry, with a purpose to make it clean, fair and efficient. Eurowag Office is the first integrated digital platform for the European CRT industry, bringing together mission-critical services across Fuel, Toll, Financial Services, Navigation, Fleet and Work Time Management. By connecting its technology, infrastructure and industry expertise through a single platform, Eurowag helps transport companies simplify complex operations, make better decisions and run more efficient and profitable businesses. Eurowag is listed on the London Stock Exchange
and is a constituent of the FTSE 250. investors.eurowag.com
